etymologies.etymologyHTML: From pea +‎ nut, perhaps a folk etymology of pinda, pinder (still found in Southern US dialects).

definitions.definition: A legume resembling a nut, the fruit of the plant Arachis hypogaea, native to South America.
(in the plural) See peanuts (“very small amount”).
(transitive) To pull on somebody's tie as a prank, causing the knot to tighten.
